integrity: The exact formula is proved analytically; exact-rational finite verification is supplementary. Exact decision NP-completeness uses binary-encoded integer cycle edge weights.
limitations: Real finite connected simple cactus graphs with at least two vertices, positive edge lengths and geodesic cycle edges; not unrestricted graph cycles sharing edges nor the best basis among all bases.
title: Exact unconditional constants of spanning-tree molecule bases on weighted cactus graphs
